title: Advance Booking Reduction on a Closing Hotel Night
content:
An advance booking reduction is taken off according to the calendar days between the day the reservation in the Hotel Rate Plans range was made and the arrival date. Where those days number 45 or more, the advance booking reduction is 7 percent. Where they number 14 or more but fewer than 45, the advance booking reduction is 3 percent. Where they number fewer than 14, the advance booking reduction is nil.

The days counted run from the day the reservation was made to the arrival date, and the departure date does not enter the count.

**Read as input, judgement and result, on hypothetical dates.**

> Input: the reservation was made 45 calendar days before arrival.
> Judgement: 45 is not fewer than 45.
> Result: 7 percent.

> Input: the reservation was made 44 calendar days before arrival.
> Judgement: fewer than 45 but not fewer than 14.
> Result: 3 percent.

> Input: the reservation was made 14 calendar days before arrival.
> Judgement: 14 is the foot of the middle band.
> Result: 3 percent.

> Input: the reservation was made 13 calendar days before arrival.
> Judgement: fewer than 14.
> Result: Nil.

> Input: the base this reduction acts on is 220.00 USD and the reservation was made 60 calendar days before arrival.
> Judgement: 60 is not fewer than 45, so the reduction is 7 percent.
> Result: 204.60 USD, rounded to the cent.
